summary: Consumed the PH-319 planning slot on main 2ec2232 (PH-309/PH-315 merged; 241 tasks, 120 done, 99 open v1.0.0 tasks) and performed the Lead-requested dependency-baseline audit. Stale dependencies were measured (top: PH-110 49, PH-181 19, PH-150 15, PH-142 11, PH-180 9, PH-185 9, PH-155 8, PH-162 8, PH-182 8) and mapped against delivered capabilities. Seven tasks were honestly promoted to ready after remapping their dependencies to done evidence: PH-293 invoice ADR (PH-214/224/232/265/284/287), PH-308 FX ADR (PH-214/224/232/287), PH-299 close/forecast ADR (PH-219/224/232/265/269/274/277/283/288/291), PH-300 project-close ADR (PH-275/283/284/287/288/291), PH-305 shared-cost contract (PH-217/244/250), PH-306 budget/ETC contract (PH-214/217/224/232/244/250/287) and PH-316 workbench export (PH-309/PH-304 both done). Each ADR/contract spec dependency/risk paragraph was updated with the old->new mapping and the write-side implementation tasks remain proposed; blockers were cleared only for the promoted tasks. Tasks whose missing capability is genuinely not delivered stay proposed with precise blockers (PH-317/318 wait on PH-293/308; PH-312/313/314 on ADR/prereqs; PH-310 on PH-285/181/182; PH-292 on PH-289/181/185). The remaining-1.0 implementation route was added as ROADMAP.md（剩余 1.0 实现路线节） (Batch A ADR freeze -> Batch B write-side first slices -> Batch C acceptance/ops and remaining gaps), and four tasks were registered continuously: PH-320 invoice implementation, PH-321 FX implementation, PH-322 close/project-close implementation (all proposed with explicit blockers) and PH-323 as the next planning slot. No product code, migration, scaffold or contract-schema change was made.
